name: Uqua: Entrance of the Ocean God Chantry
summary: Flooded stone corridors and ancient seals mark the entrance to Uqua, where Discord corruption first seeped into the Ocean God’s domain.
description: The entrance to Uqua is a drowned labyrinth of stone corridors, broken seals, and ancient carvings depicting the Ocean God’s dominion. Water flows through cracked channels, carrying Discord contamination deeper into the temple. Muramite forces maintain a foothold here, attempting to breach the Chantry’s inner sanctum. Riftseekers operate covertly, stabilizing planar leaks where possible. Discord manifestations erupt unpredictably from corrupted water, turning the entrance into a volatile battleground of ancient magic and planar instability.
